name: Basic Medical Coding Training
description: Medical coding is essential in healthcare because it converts procedures, diagnoses, and services into standardized alphanumeric codes. These codes play critical roles in billing, recordkeeping, research, and ensuring accurate insurance reimbursements
overview: This course provides essential skills and knowledge to kickstart a career in medical coding. Our meticulously crafted curriculum offers a deep understanding of healthcare coding essentials, preparing you for roles in medical coding departments, healthcare facilities, and insurance companies.

sections.title: Course Offerings:
sections.content: Participants will master the accurate translation of medical diagnoses, procedures, services, and equipment into standardized alphanumeric codes essential for billing, insurance claims, and data analysis.

sections.title: Course Topics:
content: Language of Medicines (Medical Terminology, Anatomy, Physiology, Pathology, Laboratory Techniques, etc.)
ICD-10-CM Coding Conventions and Chapter specific guidelines
Introduction to CPT Procedure Coding Terminologies
Introduction on HIPAA rules and guidelines
HCPCS basic Guidelines and Modifiers concepts
Patient report analysis with sample Medical records
Final certification exam and Mock Interview
This course is designed to equip you with comprehensive skills...

sections.title: Who This Course Is For:
content: Individuals interested in a career as a medical biller and coder

name: Certified Professional Coder

overview: Our CPC medical coding course equips you with essential skills and knowledge to launch a successful career in medical coding. Our carefully structured curriculum provides a comprehensive understanding of healthcare coding fundamentals, preparing you for positions in medical coding departments, healthcare facilities, and insurance companies

sections.title: Course Offerings:

CPC medical coding courses offer a structured and comprehensive approach to mastering medical coding principles and preparing for CPC certification. name: Advanced Medical Code Training Program
description: Our Advanced Medical Code Training Program is designed to equip students and professionals with in-depth knowledge of medical coding systems.Participants will learn accurate ICD, CPT, and HCPCS coding practices, ensuring compliance with healthcare standards.The program emphasizes practical application, real-world scenarios, and industry best practices.Our goal is to enhance career opportunities by preparing learners for professional certification and success in the medical coding field.
overview: This course provides foundational skills in medical terminology, anatomy, and basic ICD-10-CM coding, along with advanced training in complex ICD-10-CM and CPT coding, HCPCS Level II coding, and compliance with coding guidelines. You'll also receive thorough preparation for the CPC certification exam, equipping you for roles in medical coding departments, healthcare facilities, and insurance companies.

sections.title: Course Offerings:
sections.content: AMCT courses provide a structured and in-depth approach to mastering advanced medical coding principles, preparing participants for specialized certifications and career advancement. Practical, hands-on experience with complex coding scenarios ensures participants gain the skills needed for success in specialized medical coding roles across healthcare facilities and insurance companies.

Introduction on HIPAA rules and guidelines
All sections (i.e.) E&M (Evaluation and Management), Surgery, Anesthesia, Radiology, Medical Billing

The combined basic medical coding and CPC course offers a comprehensive educational experience, blending foundational knowledge with advanced CPC preparation.
